# Go Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills

## Overview

Expert Go development: HTTP handlers, database access, concurrency patterns, and idiomatic Go practices.

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [go-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
go-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@go-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Analyze query execution plans and optimize for performance
- Design database schemas following normalization and indexing best practices
- Configure backup strategies with recovery point and time objectives
- Manage data replication for high availability and disaster recovery

## Industry Standards Applied

- **IEEE 730**: Software quality assurance processes and standards
- **ISO 25010**: Software quality model: functional suitability, reliability, maintainability
